## Authority order

1. Master plan and height/biome reference.
2. Section and elevation atlas.
3. Eight directional views.
4. Environmental transition atlas.
5. Cottage architectural specification.
6. Hero and aerial composition.
7. Interior, ecology, archetype, street and prop atlases.

Where two details appear to conflict, preserve the master geographic relationships first, then the sectional elevations, then the closest detailed architectural or transition reference.
